description: This file contains JavaScript functions for managing widgets and dashboard components on the vtiger CRM homepage, including adding, deleting, loading, and arranging widgets, as well as handling AJAX requests for dynamic content updates.

methods.name: chooseType
methods.description: Handles the display and AJAX loading of different widget types based on user selection.

methods.name: setFilter
methods.description: Sets the filter list for a selected module via AJAX.

methods.name: setPrimaryFld
methods.description: Sets the primary field list for a selected filter via AJAX.

methods.name: showEditrow
methods.description: Displays the div for editing the number of rows in a widget.

methods.name: cancelEntries
methods.description: Hides the div for editing widget entries.

methods.name: saveEntries
methods.description: Saves the maximum number of entries for a widget via AJAX.

methods.name: saveEditDash
methods.description: Saves dashboard configuration via AJAX.

methods.name: DelStuff
methods.description: Deletes a widget from the homepage via AJAX.

methods.name: loadAddedDiv
methods.description: Loads a newly added widget into the homepage via AJAX.

methods.name: loadStuff
methods.description: Reloads widget content based on widget ID and type via AJAX.

methods.name: loadAllWidgets
methods.description: Loads multiple widgets in batches via AJAX.

methods.name: frmValidate
methods.description: Validates the widget creation form and submits via AJAX.

methods.name: HideDefault
methods.description: Hides a default widget via AJAX.

methods.name: fnRemoveWindow
methods.description: Hides the widget dropdown window.

methods.name: fnShowWindow
methods.description: Shows the widget dropdown window.

methods.name: positionDivInAccord
methods.description: Positions a widget div based on layout settings.

methods.name: hideSeqSettings
methods.description: Fades out the sequence settings div.

methods.name: fetch_homeDB
methods.description: Fetches the homepage dashboard content via AJAX.

methods.name: initHomePage
methods.description: Initializes sortable homepage layout.

methods.name: BlockSorting
methods.description: Saves the new order of widgets after sorting via AJAX.

methods.name: isIE
methods.description: Detects if the browser is Internet Explorer.

methods.name: addNotebookWidget
methods.description: Adds a notebook widget to the homepage via AJAX.

methods.name: addScrollBar
methods.description: Adds scrollbars to a widget div.

methods.name: showOptions
methods.description: Displays a given element centered on the screen.

methods.name: hideOptions
methods.description: Hides a given element with fade effect.

methods.name: saveLayout
methods.description: Saves the selected layout via AJAX.

methods.name: saveEditReportCharts
methods.description: Saves report chart settings via AJAX.
